problem: Exact-main production promotion failed because the GitHub OIDC bridge returned a Netlify MCP proxy that produced HTTP 401 during upload.
root_cause: The deploy transport credential in Supabase Vault was stale relative to the active Netlify MCP connection. The product build and i18n code were not the cause.
prevention: Treat Netlify MCP proxy credentials as short-lived transport state, never as durable application configuration.
On HTTP 401 from the exact-source Netlify upload path, refresh the canonical bridge credential and retry the same exact-source lineage.
Do not patch product code when deploy transport authentication is the only failing layer.
Production completion still requires exact main SHA readback and browser interaction proof.

evidence.failure: Netlify MCP exact-source upload returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized
